notes.note: Leader blocks in 0587 mapped by the script's second Pt_Chara_Check sequence: 1 W(Shotaro), 2 Rider 1, 3 OOO, 4 Den-O Sword, 5 Zero, 6 Mebius, 7 Nu, 8 Zeta, 9 Black RX, 10 Ultraman, 11 Seven, 12 Taro, 13 00, 14 Wing Zero (checked against wording: slot 4 rough, slot 6 polite, slot 11 recognises the Magma Riser, slot 14 'Mission complete' in story_107). #0.113-114 are slots 13-14 of the block begun at #0.101 (story_107). Identical Japanese -> identical English.

Speaker unlabelled; most likely OOO continuing from #0.117 (Eiji knows Dr. Maki), then brushing it off in #0.119. 'He' = Dinosaur Greeed (glossary g=m). 'Pulled into this' = drawn over to the enemy side.

#0.122-135: 14-slot block, same order. Plain 'modoru ka' -> 'I guess we should head back'; 'modorou' -> 'let's'; #0.134 (00, formal 'kikan') -> 'we're returning'. Trailing 'mo' rendered 'too'. #0.125 Momotaros: 'him' for Accel (g=m).
'Terror Field' as in earlier slices (not in glossary). 'That room in the back' = the room further in, past where the field was.

Item: Magma Riser (Ultraseven's Ultra Garrison drill tank). 'Magma Riser Drill' matches the existing enemy-skill table rendering. Not in glossary; quoted item format follows the 'Pelucidar Drill' line.
#0.146-159: 14-slot block, same order; #0.146 labelled W (Philip) = slot 1. #0.156 (Seven) recognises it as the Magma Riser's drill. 'Ride Machine' per glossary.
Speaker ??? (CHARA_NAME 30), same ??? as 0601 #0.1 (uses boku). Addresses unnamed subordinates politely; identity not settled, so no pronouns used.
#0.173/#0.175/#0.177: stray extra variants (likely the 15th slot, God Gundam, absent from the 14-row blocks); identical Japanese to other rows, so identical English.
Terror continues from story_107 #0.74 (memories already installed), answering Ankh's 'What do you mean?'. #0.185-199: 15-slot 'Veda!?' block, all identical.
Zoffy. Which Cube is not stated; kept indefinite 'a Cube' and passive. #0.2: subject of 'send in' restored as 'we'; 'I'll have them' for the causative.
Speaker ??? (CHARA_NAME 30) per script: a villain whose Cube the heroes have found.

0602 triplets mapped by its second Pt_Chara_Check sequence: 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam, Nu, Zeta, Zero (then Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1 in story_109; the W and Momotaros triplets there confirm the order). 'Toritsuita' (latched onto the enemy Cube) -> 'boarded'. Who gave the invasion-route order is not shown in 0588, so 'we were told' (passive) instead of 'he said'.
Zero's triplet continues into story_109 #0.18; line trails off as in the source.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader blocks mapped by Pt_Chara_Check order + wording. Uncertain: #0.118-119 speaker (likely OOO); ??? identity (#0.168-169, 0601 #0.1); 0588 #0.1 which Cube; 0602 invasion-route order giver unknown (passive). Not in glossary: Terror Field, Magma Riser Drill, Veda.
